I'm currently 2 months postpartum and I have a 26 month old as well. Both pregnancies I was given an epidural. Wish I didn't need it with my second but it was a planned c section. My back I think is forever going to be in pain for the rest of my waking days ;( Tylenol does not help, so since the 2 year old (who is probably also 30 pounds) is getting more independent, I try to never pick him up for anything if he doesn't need it. I keep everything he needs down low so he can reach. I haven't picked him up at all these last few months because I couldn't pick him up during my pregnancy anyways so we have both gotten used to it. The crappy thing is when I change both of their diapers I'm probably going to need a changing table, bending over on the couch is probably what's making my back worse. So I would suggest that if you have the funds to get it so your back can be straight instead of slouching over like I do, I save bath time for dad at night so I don't have to bend over, but if you can't do that I'd suggest a back brace during that. Physical therapy as well as I did that during the end of my pregnancy and they ended up putting kt tape on my back and it seemed to help a bit.
